Government announces pension for persons with 40% disability from birth

The Union Cabinet has approved a decision to provide pensions to individuals with 40% disability from birth. This decision was announced by Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw. The names of several schemes have also been changed as part of this initiative.
